title: Sign team charter
body: Each member signs and submits their own copy of the PREACH charter (0.4). Gates the Welcome to the course module.

title: Kick-off meeting
body: 90-minute kick-off: agree bank(s) and business questions PREACH charter roles and section ownership cadence and tools. Actions read back with owners and dates.

title: Verify transcript availability
body: Confirm downloadable Q&A transcripts exist for HSBC and Barclays across enough recent quarters before scope is finalised.

title: Resolve open scope question
body: Decide via WhatsApp whether to add a third US-based bank for geopolitical comparison. Currently undecided.

title: Build project roadmap
body: Build roadmap against the four 1.1.5 inclusions (goals initiatives milestones progress). Post to discussion board and reply to one other group via 3CQ.

title: Porter's Five Forces analysis
body: Run and post the Porter's Five Forces market analysis (1.3.4).

title: Draft Assignment 1 sections
body: Each section owner drafts their part in the single shared document roughly to word budget.

title: Consolidate to 1000 words
body: One editor unifies tone and cuts the draft to 1000 words plus or minus 10 percent.

title: Final review against marking guide
body: Whole team reviews the draft against the four marking criteria then exports to PDF and checks formatting.

title: Submit Assignment 1
body: Designated member submits Group9_CAM_EP_Assignment1.pdf by midday UK.

title: Source transcripts
body: Source Q&A transcripts and earnings reports for HSBC and Barclays from investor relations pages.

title: Preprocess transcripts
body: Clean and preprocess transcript text with speaker segmentation.

title: Topic modelling pipeline
body: Build BERTopic clustering pipeline on analyst Q&A themes. Themes are data-driven after initial feature engineering not fixed in advance.

title: Sentiment analysis pipeline
body: Build sentiment pipeline combining FinBERT with LDSA per topic cluster.

title: Draft preliminary findings
body: Draft preliminary findings for the Assignment 2 pitch.

title: Build presentation deck
body: Build and record the Assignment 2 presentation deck. 15 minutes.

title: Submit Assignment 2
body: Submit the Assignment 2 deck PDF and recording.

title: Summarisation pipeline
body: Build LLM summarisation pipeline grouped by metric.

title: Refine topic modelling
body: Repeat topic modelling on the clusters that turn out to matter based on initial results.

title: Hand-validate model outputs
body: Hand-validate a sample of topic assignments and sentiment labels. Report FinBERT's known weakness on hedged bank language explicitly.

title: Evaluate against three baselines
body: Evaluate results against temporal peer and structured-versus-unstructured baselines rather than a single accuracy figure.

title: Write final report
body: Write the final report. 1500 words. State what re-running the pipeline next quarter would cost.

title: Prepare final presentation
body: Prepare the final live presentation deck for the Bank of England.

title: Submit Assignment 3
body: Submit the final report code and deck then give the live presentation.

title: Team retrospective
body: Hold a team retrospective before final submission.

title: Submit Assignment 4
body: Each member submits their individual reflection. 500 words.

title: M1 — Corpus acquired and verified
body:
**Gate:** M1 — Tue 16 Sep 2026
**Owner:** Evidence pair

**Test:** Corpus acquired and verified. Manifest lists 20 documents (2 banks × 10 quarters) with zero missing quarters and a recorded source and publication date for each.

**If blocked:** Missing quarter: reduce to eight quarters per bank, log the decision, proceed the same day.

title: M2 — Evidence table built
body:
**Gate:** M2 — Fri 19 Sep 2026
**Owner:** Evidence pair

**Test:** Evidence table built. Turns and question-answer pairs extracted for every document; at least 95% of turns attributed to a named speaker and speaker type; every row carries bank, quarter, date, section and provenance.

**If blocked:** Layout variance between banks: build a parser per bank; two days of buffer held in week 3.

title: M3 — Numeric claims extracted
body:
**Gate:** M3 — Tue 23 Sep 2026
**Owner:** Evidence pair

**Test:** Numeric claims extracted, each with value, unit and time horizon; precision of at least 0.8 measured on a 50-row manual audit.

**If blocked:** Below threshold: restrict to a defined metric list rather than open extraction.

title: M4 — Topics and sentiment assigned
body:
**Gate:** M4 — Fri 26 Sep 2026
**Owner:** Signals pair

**Test:** Topics and sentiment assigned. Every question-answer pair carries a topic label and separate question and answer sentiment; at least 70% agreement with human labels on a 60-pair stratified sample.

**If blocked:** Unstable clusters: fall back to the seeded keyword taxonomy. Decision point fixed on this date.

title: M5 — Assignment 2 submitted
body:
**Gate:** M5 — Mon 28 Sep 2026
**Owner:** Synthesis

**Test:** Assignment 2 submitted: deck as PDF plus a recording of 15 minutes ±10%.

**If blocked:** Dry run held 26 September so re-recording remains possible.

title: M6 — Behavioural signals computed
body:
**Gate:** M6 — Wed 30 Sep 2026
**Owner:** Signals pair

**Test:** Behavioural signals computed. Answer directness, metric-request coverage and topic-substitution rate calculated per pair and aggregated per bank-quarter.

**If blocked:** Reduce to directness and metric coverage; substitution rate is the droppable measure.

title: M7 — Supervisory mapping complete
body:
**Gate:** M7 — Fri 2 Oct 2026
**Owner:** Domain analyst

**Test:** Supervisory mapping complete. Every observed topic mapped to one of eight prudential categories, dual-coded by two members with disagreements resolved and recorded.

**If blocked:** Runs in parallel from week 3 and therefore never sits on the critical path.

title: M8 — Snapshots and comparisons produced
body:
**Gate:** M8 — Tue 6 Oct 2026
**Owner:** Synthesis

**Test:** Snapshots and comparisons produced. One state summary per bank-quarter plus all three comparison views, rendered with axes and sample sizes labelled.

**If blocked:** Drop the peer comparison first; the other two carry the argument alone.

title: M9 — Findings validated
body:
**Gate:** M9 — Thu 8 Oct 2026
**Owner:** Synthesis

**Test:** Findings validated. Every headline finding traced to at least three evidence records by identifier; limitations section written and agreed by the team.

**If blocked:** A finding that cannot be traced is cut rather than softened.

title: M10 — Report and presentation complete
body:
**Gate:** M10 — Sat 10 Oct 2026
**Owner:** Synthesis

**Test:** Report and presentation complete. Report at 1,500 words ±10%, deck timed at 15 minutes ±10% in a full dry run, code runnable end to end from the artefact files.

**If blocked:** Two days of buffer to the deadline by design.

title: A3 live — Assignment 3 submitted to Bank of England
body:
**Gate:** A3 submit — Mon 12 Oct 2026
**Owner:** Project lead

**Test:** Assignment 3 submitted: report, code, deck and live presentation to the Bank of England.

**If blocked:** None specified — M10 buffer (two days) is the contingency.
